description: Matrix mixer, four by four, with switches instead of knobs

params.text: Every switch is off by default; a click passes that input into that output mix at unity gain

inputs.text: That row's signal, which the switches along the row pass into any of the four output mixes

outputs.text: The sum of the rows whose switch in that column is on, soft-clipped at 12V

notes: a switch's own right-click menu takes a typed level from -100% to 100%, so a switch can pass an attenuated or inverted signal
switches slew slightly when they change, so they do not pop
every switch starts off, so nothing reaches any output until switches are turned on
menu: Input gain — cuts every input before the mix: Unity, -3dB, -6dB or -12dB
Output clipping — Soft/saturated (better for audio) rounds the output off at 12V, Hard/clipped (better for CV) cuts it there and so sums CVs exactly, and None leaves it uncapped
Average — divides each output mix by the number of connected inputs instead of summing them
Inverting — Disabled stops a switch inverting at all; By param entry (right-click) allows a negative level to be typed; On second click makes a second click on a switch invert it
Exclusive switching by rows — only one switch in a row may be on at a time
Exclusive switching by columns — only one switch in a column may be on at a time
